name: mirewick_palace

extra_pieces.notes: Counting-House: purple-and-gold vault, the Clerk's desk, Scrip-Desk block, vault chest (Dark Lanterns opens it)
Council chamber: five seats, the First Lantern on a pedestal (never lit by the player)
gatehouse of pale stone over a dry canal quay, purple banners
Sluice tower on the dike: lantern roof, Dikemaster's post
shop kiosk for the Scrip-Desk villager

never: valuable blocks (gold, diamond, emerald, iron blocks, gilded blackstone)
